scope: PWA cold-entry hotfix; author verification in an isolated Chromium context

publishedBaseline.interpretation: Long blank battle preload while automatic full precache competes for the connection; no permanent JavaScript crash reproduced.

comparisonWithServiceWorkersBlocked.context: Fresh Chromium context; serviceWorkers:block; baseline browser closed first

publishedBaseline.timingLimit: Two sequential public network observations, not a universal performance benchmark. Local fixed timing below is not comparable with public CDN transfer time.

fixedBuild.note: Root may rebuild after the separate battle-controller lane freezes; this evidence identifies the exact locally tested generation.

freshVisit.timingLimit: Localhost only; proves removal of automatic worker downloads, not production latency.

partialActiveCacheRepair.mutationScope: Only play.html was removed from this isolated browser's own current cache

cancelDownloadOnMatchEntry.fixture: Held only the service-worker-owned buildings.png request; normal page asset requests remained available

legacyWorkerEscape.fixture: Exact 4b1d4c9 worker code with one pinned synthetic index.html resource instead of a complete artwork download

toolbarBounds.engine: Chromium touch contexts with an iPhone user agent; not actual Safari or physical iPhone

limitations: No public publishing or credentials access was performed by this worker.
No physical Safari, native PWA installation, full offline battle completion or app-store package validation was performed.
Other lanes own the static bootstrap, battle loading UI, retry/cancel controller and final deployment verification.
